# Test fixture font

`studio-test-sans.ttf` is a synthetic font created for this repository's
tests. It is not distributed as a font product and is never loaded by end
users.

The file carries no third-party copyright, license, vendor, or designer name
records, and its family name (`Zee Studio Test Sans`) is specific to this
project. It exists only to exercise font loading, bundling, and
duplicate-family handling in the Studio checks.

Like the rest of this repository, this fixture is covered by the MIT license
in the root `LICENSE` file.
